title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 250 (Effect of company notified as dissolved)

content.overview: Where a company stands dissolved under section 248, it ceases to operate as a company and the certificate of incorporation is deemed to have been cancelled, except for the purpose of realising the amount due to the company and for payment of its liabilities.

Where a company stands dissolved under section 248, it ceases to operate as a company and the certificate of incorporation is deemed to have been cancelled, except for the purpose of realising the amount due to the company and for payment of its liabilities. sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Dissolution does not wipe out liabilities of officers and members, which section 248 preserves. Restoration is section 252.
